description:
The Huffy ZRX 16" Kids Bike brings bold BMX-inspired style to every ride. Built with a durable steel frame and motocross-style design, this bike is ready for neighborhood cruising, driveway practice, and riding with friends. Young riders get the look and feel of a freestyle bike while building confidence on two wheels.
The ZRX features Huffy’s EZ Build system, designed to make bike assembly faster and simpler. With a streamlined setup process and fewer steps, parents can get the bike ready with less hassle so riders can start their next adventure sooner.
Training wheels provide added stability while new riders build balance and confidence. A coaster brake allows simple pedal-back stopping, while the front hand brake adds responsive control. BMX-style front pegs and a crossbar pad complete the freestyle look, giving riders extra style as they cruise and explore.

components.description: Dual Brake System: Coaster brake for easy pedal-back stopping plus a front hand brake for added control as skills grow.
